text:
Ava (Partnerships): Heads-up — CloudVendor + EdgeHW joint webinar confirmed for May 12. Need final run order, speaker bios, demo handoff plan, and a tight plan for swag pickup. Can people drop availability for a 20m pre-show sync?

Diego (Events): I can do 10:30–11:00 PT tomorrow. I sketched a 30m run-of-show but we can compress to 20. Key risks: demo network, checkout flow, and last-minute speaker slides.

Priya (Field Marketing): +1 for run-of-show. Also need final headshots & 1-line speaker blurbs for the registration page by EOD Friday. I can upload the RSVP landing page once I have them.

Sam (Solutions): For the live demo: primary is hosted model on Redwood Hosted API; fallback is a quantized model on EdgeHW box. Need a health-check script and transparent fallback messaging. Recommend this snippet for the pre-demo check:```bash
# quick demo smoke test
curl -sS -X POST https://demo.redwood.local/generate -d '{"prompt":"health-check"}' | jq '.status'
```

Marta (Logistics): Swag plan: 150 sample kits. I'll route 50 to CloudVendor booth, 50 to EdgeHW booth, 50 reserved for walk-ups. Shipping ETA to partner courier: 5 days. Tracker: TRK-772334-PT. Fragile stickers applied.

Alex (Partner Success): Speakers: Elena (CloudVendor, Dir Product), Rakesh (EdgeHW, Eng Lead), and our guest panelist Mira (SI partner). I have short bios but need one-sentence highlights from each speaker on what they’ll demo. @Elena @Rakesh @Mira can you drop those?

Ava (Partnerships): Good list. Also let's define guest flow: 1) intro 3m, 2) 12m joint demo (CloudVendor + EdgeHW), 3) 10m panel with SI use-case, 4) Q&A. Timeboxed. Need explicit handoff points: when CloudVendor stops streaming, EdgeHW starts.

Diego (Events): Proposed cueing: Host counts down, CloudVendor shares screen, at 11:30 host mutes CloudVendor's screen share and prompts EdgeHW to start screenshare. I'll be on mute control + countdown in Slack backstage channel. Add visual cue text: "EdgeHW go in 3...2...1".

Sam (Solutions): For model fallback, I'll add a lightweight status banner in the demo UI: "Using local fallback mode — slight latency improvement, identical output format." We'll also log events to the console: `FALLBACK_ACTIVE=true` — will create a short runbook for the ops person.

Marta (Logistics): For swag pickup at venue: warehouse will stage kits at 08:30. Need two volunteer IDs to sign pickup form. Who can spare someone for 09:00 check-in?

Priya (Field Marketing): I can have two interns handle pickup and handouts. Will coordinate shipping labels and badge ribbons. Also planning a quick photo moment at 12:45 — will need consent forms for partner speakers.

Alex (Partner Success): I'll chase speaker blurbs. Also can someone confirm we have marketplace asset ready? CloudVendor wants the joint listing live day-of.

Ava (Partnerships): Marketplace asset status: checklist: 1) joint blurb (Priya), 2) partner logo approvals (Alex), 3) deploy link + demo GIF (Sam), 4) verified pricing metadata (CloudVendor finance). Priya/Alex/Sam please confirm.

DeployBot: Rehearsal scheduled: "Joint Webinar Rehearsal" set for May 11 16:00 PT. Calendar invite sent to thread participants.

Diego (Events): OK everyone — next steps: everyone to the rehearsal (May 11 16:00 PT). Priya send landing page copy by Fri EOD. Alex confirm logos by Mon. Sam drop the smoke-test runbook in the shared drive. Marta finalize tracking & volunteer names by Mon AM. I'll produce the stage cue cheat-sheet and post in #events-backstage. :white_check_mark:

Ava (Partnerships): Thanks — closing thread. I'll compile action items and ping folks individually. @here please flag anything missing. :sparkles:
